targets.decision: A visitor can identify the specimen-family input before choosing a value.
targets.behavior: The visible label sits above and remains programmatically associated with the select.
targets.consequence: The selection loses its accessible name and scanning anchor.

targets.decision: A late preview preserves the current accepted state and reports its generation.
targets.behavior: The initiating control retains focus and stale completion receives a typed status.
targets.consequence: A late response can replace a newer review context.

targets.decision: The workflow remains readable at 320 CSS pixels and enlarged text.
targets.behavior: Both named cards retain content, reading order, and non-overlap inside the workflow while every named select and button retains a usable hit area.
targets.consequence: Content clips or creates horizontal reading work.

targets.decision: The primary action consumes the accepted semantic action token.
targets.behavior: The computed button background resolves to the accepted contract value.
targets.consequence: Local CSS drifts from the reviewed semantic contract.

targets.decision: The connector communicates flow while each card remains visually primary.
targets.behavior: The connector paints behind the two cards inside one bounded workflow crop.
targets.consequence: The connector crosses card content and changes the visual hierarchy.
